name: Georgia Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
notes: Researched from public dor.georgia.gov pages only. Georgia Tax Center (GTC): Quick Payment without login (SSN or tax ID), saved bank payment sources with a login, electronic payments scheduled on or before the due date (later dates refused) and cancellable before 3:00 p.m. ET on the payment date. Card/PayPal via a third-party vendor at 2.31% ($1 minimum, not expressible); card payments cannot be cancelled and are not accepted for amended returns. Payment plans requested in GTC (More > Payments and Returns > Request Payment Plan) with bank debit and electronic notices required, or by Form GA-9465. No recurring AutoPay for balances (unsupported, inferred). Sign-in by username inferred.

guest_pay.note: Make a Quick Payment in the Georgia Tax Center without logging in, using the Account ID from your notice and your last name.

autopay.note: GTC has no recurring automatic payments for tax balances. Schedule each electronic payment on or before its due date; an approved payment plan debits your bank account automatically.

help.title: How to make a tax payment
paragraphs: Pay individual income tax and assessed liabilities in the Georgia Tax Center (GTC) or by mail. Electronic payments can be set up to occur on or before the due date.
Quick Payments need no GTC login, only your SSN or tax ID. With a GTC login you can save one or more bank payment sources for later use.

Credit cards and PayPal carry a 2.31% convenience fee ($1.00 minimum) charged by a third-party vendor; the Department keeps none of it. Cards are not accepted for amended return payments, and card payments cannot be cancelled once submitted. To pay by mail, send a check or money order with Form 525-TV, IT-560 or 500-ES as applicable.

help.title: Make a Quick Payment
paragraphs: Quick Payment in GTC lets you pay without logging in.
steps: Go to the Georgia Tax Center and under Tasks select Make a Quick Payment.
Review the request details and select Next.
Choose Individual as the customer type and Social Security # or Individual Taxpayer ID # as the ID type.
Say whether you have a payment number, complete the ID, payor and payment information.
Review, submit, and keep the confirmation number.

help.title: Cancel or time a payment
paragraphs: An electronic payment can be cancelled until 3:00 p.m. Eastern on the payment date you entered. Credit card payments cannot be cancelled.
When the due date falls on a weekend or holiday, set up an EFT payment before 3 p.m. Eastern on or before the last business day before the due date. Payment dates after the due date are not accepted.

help.title: Request a payment plan
paragraphs: Payment plans are available for individual income tax. Request one online in GTC or with Form GA-9465.

You must agree to receive electronic notices about the plan and authorize the Department to debit your bank account until the plan is complete. Once approved, the terms appear as a web notice in the GTC Action Center.
steps: Under the More tab, open Payments and Returns and select Request Payment Plan.
Review the terms and enter your banking information.
Optionally add a down payment, then enter the first payment date and number of payments.
Agree to electronic notices, review the conditions and submit; enter your GTC password to authorize the debits.

extra.intent: Using the Georgia DOR website's help pages, find the time by which an electronic payment must be cancelled on its payment date. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Electronic payments must be cancelled before 3:00 p.m. Eastern on the payment date.

extra.intent: Using the Georgia DOR website's help pages, find the convenience fee for paying by credit card or PayPal. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Cards and PayPal carry a 2.31% convenience fee with a $1.00 minimum.
